note: Proposed update to book_calendar tool definitions on Retell LLM (llm_f590da6bf200b042e3dcb25b3648)
reason: Current cal_fields descriptions are too generic — agent needs to know the exact schema and where data comes from
current_description: Check available appointment slots for the next 7 days
proposed_description: Check available appointment slots for the next 7 days. Retell sends start_time/end_time to Cal.com GET /v2/slots/available. The response returns availability_range per date. Offer 1-2 slots to the customer from the available times. Never offer a slot that isn't in the results.
Book a confirmed appointment slot via Cal.com v2 API. Call ONLY after customer has verbally confirmed the full booking readback. Retell sends the payload below to POST /v2/bookings.

current.name: attendeePhoneNumber
current.description: attendeePhoneNumber (number must be valid number in e.164 format)

proposed.name: name
proposed.description: Customer's full name — {{customer_name}} captured earlier in the call. Maps to attendee.name in Cal.com.

proposed.name: email
proposed.description: Customer's email address. If customer has no email or refuses to provide one, use 'no-email@example.com' as a required placeholder. Maps to attendee.email in Cal.com.

proposed.name: attendeePhoneNumber
proposed.description: Customer's phone number in E.164 format (e.g., +447700900567). Extracted from {{caller_phone_number}} or what the customer stated during the call. Maps to attendee.phoneNumber in Cal.com.

proposed.name: title
proposed.description: Appointment title shown in the calendar event. Format: '{{problem_category}} — {{customer_name}}'. Example: 'Boiler Breakdown — Dave Smith'. Maps to booking title in Cal.com.

proposed.name: notes
guests
proposed.description: Additional email addresses to add as guests/CC on the calendar event. Only populate if the customer explicitly provides additional email addresses. Each must be a valid email. Maps to Cal.com attendees list.

proposed.name: rescheduleReason
proposed.description: Only used when rebooking/rescheduling an existing appointment. For new bookings, leave empty or omit. Maps to rescheduleReason in Cal.com.

calcom_v2_mapping.note: Not 'phone' or 'phone_number' — must be attendeePhoneNumber in Retell, maps to phoneNumber in Cal.com
